jobs.title: Automation QA Engineer (Lead)
jobs.excerpt: Bug Squisher Wanted: You’re an expert at making sure websites, storefronts, and backend systems work smoothly before they go live.
jobs.description:
Bug Squisher Wanted: You’re an expert at making sure websites, storefronts, and backend systems work smoothly before they go live. But you don’t just catch bugs. You build the systems that catch bugs before anyone else ever sees them. You can spot flaky tests from a mile away. Your test architecture is clean, scalable, and easy for other developers to follow. And when it comes to troubleshooting, you’re relentless — in the best possible way.

If this sounds like you, and you’re excited about a workday that’s fun, collaborative, technical, and full of purpose, let’s chat!

AlgaeCal is on the lookout for a Lead QA Developer to bring their skills to our lively QA team and help transform lives, one stable release at a time.

Small print here ⇒ We’re an eCommerce company. So, we want you to have eCommerce experience. Lots of it. You’ll be helping us improve the quality, stability, and reliability of our React-based storefront and internal middleware. So if automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and digital marketing technology don’t light at least a small fire in your belly, you probably shouldn’t read any further.

Still here? Okay then…

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

You’ll love it here:

  • You’ll be working with a great team. The developers at AlgaeCal have been there, done that, and got the t-shirt. They’ve written more code than Alan Turing. They’ve learned more programming languages than C3PO. They’ve immersed themselves in so many development tasks that they’ve had to be pulled out of the Matrix by their ankles on a Friday evening. And the best part? They’re friendly, funny, and easy to work with.
  • You’ll use your powers for good. This isn’t one of those jobs that crush your soul with mindless tasks. On the contrary! You’ll help build the quality engineering systems that let us ship better storefront experiences, stronger middleware, and more reliable eCommerce platforms — all so we can spread a powerful message: bone loss is beatable.
  • You won’t be micromanaged. We’ll give you a clear set of KPIs, meaningful ownership, and crystal clear expectations. You’ll know what success looks like: stronger automation frameworks, cleaner CI/CD integration, fewer flaky tests, better reporting, and fewer defects slipping through to production.
  • We don’t have mattresses at the office. Seriously Elon, what’s up with that?!? You’ll be relieved to know this isn’t one of those Silicon Valley gigs that expects you to work ridiculously long hours and frowns upon family time. We’re not like that! We enjoy our life, and we want you to enjoy yours too.

This job might be for you if you’ve got…

  • 5+ years of QA development experience, with real examples of automated testing strategies you’ve built, maintained, improved, or scaled.
  • 2+ years of leadership, mentorship, or coaching experience. You don’t need a giant ego or a fancy title. But you do need to know how to guide other QA developers, review their work, support their growth, and raise the technical standard of the team.
  • A strong command of JavaScript and TypeScript. You don’t need to speak in code at dinner parties, (in fact, please don’t), but you should be very comfortable writing, reviewing, and improving automated tests in a modern JS/TS environment.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks like Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools. If you’ve ever made a flaky test suite faster, cleaner, and more reliable, we’d love to hear about it.
  • The know-how to architect, optimize, and scale automated testing frameworks across frontend storefronts and backend middleware. Around here, that means working across our Shopify Hydrogen storefront and middleware
  • Experience integrating automated tests into cloud-based CI/CD pipelines. You understand that automation is only useful if it gives developers fast, reliable feedback, and doesn’t randomly blow up the build because someone sneezed near the test runner.
  • A sharp eye for quality metrics. We’re talking automation coverage, pipeline stability, test execution runtimes, flaky test reduction, production defect leakage, and the kind of reporting that helps the whole team make better decisions.
  • Comfort with specialized QA spaces like API contract testing, performance profiling, load testing, and browser developer tool profiling. You don’t have to know everything. But you do need to be curious, technical, and willing to dig. We’d also be impressed if you’ve worked with Python, PHP, Figma, Storybook, or Jest.
  • Next level bug prevention skills. In fact, you’re so good at dealing with bugs you should probably be deployed on a mission to Klendathu.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you?

If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.

Other Qualities You’ll Need

At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • You’re humble — you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
  • You’re hungry to learn more
  • You’re people smart — in the sense that you’re a great teammate

The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.

You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:

  • A generous healthcare package
  • Monthly team events and activities
  • Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
  • Casual dress code

And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Lead QA Developer is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

Write a cover letter addressing:

Why are you the best Lead QA Developer for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements, especially around automation frameworks, CI/CD testing, defect reduction, flaky test reduction, QA metrics, or mentoring other QA developers.

1. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here:

2. What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?

3. What are the last three books you’ve read?

4. What do you do for fun?

5. Explain what you’re doing now for a job:

6. If you don’t have one, explain why.

7. If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere.

Upload your cover letter and resume

Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best — and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!

Wannado Marketing on paikkariippumattoman työn pioneeri ja diginomadien unelmatyönantaja. Meitä on jo noin 15 pääosin Suomessa ja Espanjassa, mutta myös esimerkiksi Italiassa ja Ranskassa. Korostamme itsenäistä työskentelyä, tiimityön ja parviälyn voimaa sekä mahdollisuutta kehittää osaamistaan haluamaansa suuntaan. Kiinnostuitko?

Täyden palvelun digitoimistona me tarvitsemme tekniikan tähtiä, visuaalisia velhoja ja laajoja kokonaisuuksia hallitsevia digimarkkinoijia. Sun ei siis missään nimessä tarvitse hallita näitä kaikkia, vaan voidaan viilata kokonaisuudesta osaamistasi ja toiveitasi vastaava paketti ja jättää loput muille. Teet töitä eri projekteissa itsenäisellä otteella ja osana markkinoinnin ammattilaisista koostuvaa tiimiämme.

Meillä on ihania pk-yritysasiakkaita laidasta laitaan eri toimialoilta, ja teemme kaikkemme tarjotaksemme helposti ja joustavasti viimeisen päälle laadukasta palvelua. Sinulla on can do -asennetta, joka tarkoittaa, että ettet pelkää haasteita ja opettelet tarvittaessa uutta. Oman alasi asiantuntijana seuraat aktiivisesti digimarkkinoinnin kenttää, osaat kertoa asiakkaillemme alan uusimmista trendeistä ja suositella juuri heille parhaat ratkaisut.

Mitä meillä on sitten ihan käytännössä tarjolla? Tässäpä ne kysytyimmät:

  • Markkinointiviestintää: AI-avusteista sisällöntuotantoa (blogitekstit, artikkelit, uutiskirjeet, tiedotteet, somet – mitä näitä nyt on), käännöksiä (etenkin suomeksi ja englanniksi, mutta kaikki kielitaito on plussaa!).

  • Markkinoinnin päälliköintiä: strategista suunnittelua, vuosikelloja, projektinjohtoa, tiiminvetoa, myyntiä ja asiakasvastaavan töitä.

  • Digimarkkinointia:TikTok, LinkedIn, Twitter (X), Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Google Ads, Bing Ads, SEO, kampanjoiden suunnittelu, optimointi ja raportointi.

  • Digisuunnittelua: UI/UX suunnittelu, somemateriaalit, videot, animaatiot, yritysilmeet, grafiikkaa ja taittoa myös printtiin. Työkaluina Canva, Figma, Adobe CC.

  • Verkkosivuja ja analytiikkaa:WordPress, WIX, Webflow, SquareSpace yms valmisalustat, webanalytiikka (GTM, Search Console, GA4, Piwik, Matomo yms)

  • Automaatioita ja integraatioita: erilaisten markkinoinnin ja myynnin työkalujen yhdistämistä toisiinsa ja edelleen muihin järjestelmiin. Asialistalla esimerkiksi Pipedrive, Leadoo, Looker Studio, Unbounce, Hubspot, Slack, ActiveCampaign, Power BI, Netvisor, Zapier, Supermetrics…

Palamme halusta kuulla, mistä markkinoinnin tehtävistä just sun unelmatyö koostuu! Kerro meille ainakin nämä:
  • Oleellinen osaaminen, tutut työkalut ja mitä haluat oppia
  • Missä maassa haluat työskennellä
  • Mikä on palkkatoiveesi (€/h tai €/kk)
  • Laskutatko vai haluatko tehdä työsopimuksen
  • Kaipaatko osa-aikaista vai kokoaikaista työtä
  • Milloin voit aloittaa

Requirements

  • Sujuva suomen kieli
  • Sujuva englanti
  • Diginatiivin tietotekniset taidot
  • Kaupallinen ajattelu ja markkinoinnin alan ymmärrys
  • Kokemusta itsenäisestä työskentelystä markkinoinnin tehtävissä
  • Oma-aloitteisuutta ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

Benefits

  • 100% remote first - sinun näköinen elämä ja työ siellä, missä sinä ja läheisesi voitte hyvin.
  • Joustava työaika - meitä ei kiinnosta minä päivänä tai mihin aikaan teet, kunhan sovitut hommat hoituu.
  • Perheystävällinen työnantaja - meillä on monella lapsia ja perhettä mukana maailmalla.
  • Kansainväliset verkostot - tapaat työssäsi mielenkiintoisia yrittäjiä ja tekijöitä eri maista ja eri toimialoilta.
  • Koulutukset - kun sinun ja meidän intressit kohtaavat, tulee mahdolliseksi tehdä työn ohessa esimerkiksi oppisopimuksella erilaisia markkinoinnin, myynnin ja johtamisen tutkintoja.
Palkkahaarukka 2000€-3500€ / 100% työaika
Työllistämme useissa maissa erilaisilla sopimuksilla ja paikallisten ehtojen mukaan. Esimerkiksi Espanjassa tekijämme ovat espanjalaisen yrityksemme palkkalistoilla ja espanjalaisen työlainsäädännön piirissä, tai laskuttavat omalla yrityksellään. Maksamme aina paikallisen tason mukaista palkkaa, olit sitten osa-aikainen tai kokopäiväinen. Palkkaan vaikuttavat sijaintisi lisäksi tietysti myös osaamisesi ja aiempi työkokemuksesi.

Miten haku etenee?

Tämä ilmoitus on vuoden ympäri auki oleva avoin hakemus ilman määräaikaa. Saamme paljon hakemuksia, ja valitettavasti emme aina ehdi vastata henkilökohtaisesti kaikkiin. Asiakkaidemme tarpeet muuttuvat nopeasti, ja etsimme erilaisia tekijöitä asiakkaillemme useita kertoja vuodessa. Katsomme aina ensin avoimet hakemukset ja olemme yhteydessä mikäli profiilisi matchaa tarpeisiimme.

jobs.description:
About TylSemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TylSemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP — the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks — that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path.

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

• Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.

• Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI — they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.

• IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.

Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing.

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

• If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.

• No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

• US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location

• India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.

What We Value

• Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it.

• Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here.

• Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.

• Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.

Here's why you should:

• The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building.

• The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo.

• The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.

• The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk.

READY TO JOIN?

Role Overview

As an Analog Design Engineer at Tylsemi, you will design and deliver high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits that enable robust, manufacturable silicon. This role spans a wide experience range (5–30 years) and is ideal for engineers who combine strong fundamentals with practical execution—translating system requirements into silicon-ready designs, validating performance across corners, and partnering closely with layout, verification, test, and product teams to drive first-time-right outcomes.

WhatYou’llDo

  • Own end-to-end analog block development: requirements definition, architecture, transistor-level design, simulation, and signoff
  • Design andoptimizeanalog/mixed-signal circuits such as amplifiers, references, biasing, regulators (LDO/DC-DC support), comparators, oscillators/clocking, data converters (as applicable), and sensor/AFE front ends
  • Drive performance across PVT corners, mismatch/Monte Carlo, aging/reliability considerations, and realistic loading/interaction with surrounding blocks
  • Partner with layout to guidefloorplanning, matching/guarding strategies, parasitic-aware design, and post-layout closure (PEX)
  • Develop and maintain testbenches, modeling collateral, and documentation to enable efficient verification and integration
  • Support silicon bring-up and debug: correlate lab data to simulations, root-cause issues, and implement design fixes or ECOs
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with digital, firmware, DFT, validation, and product engineering to ensure system-level success
  • Contribute to designmethodologyimprovements: reusable circuits, checklists, signoff flows, and best practices that scale across programs

WhatWe’reLooking For

  • 5+ years of experience in analog or mixed-signal IC design (scope and ownership aligned to experience level)
  • Strong fundamentals in analog circuit design, device physics, noise, stability/compensation, and feedback systems
  • Proficiencywith industry-standard EDA tools and simulation flows (e.g.,Spectre/HSPICE, ADE, waveform/debug tooling)
  • Experience closing designs through post-layoutparasiticsand across process/voltage/temperature corners
  • Ability to translate ambiguous system needs into clear block requirements and executable design plans
  • Strong debugging skills and comfort working with lab/validation teams to correlate silicon to simulation
  • Clear communication and high ownership in cross-site, cross-functional environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience with high-speed or precision analog (low-noise, low-offset, high-linearity) depending on product needs
  • Background in power management (LDOs, bandgaps, references, protection, start-up, transient response)
  • ADC/DAC, Power related analog experience
  • Familiarity with reliability/ESD considerations and design-for-manufacturability practices
  • Experience supporting production ramp: yield learning, characterization, and test correlation

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Analog blocks meet spec with margin across PVT, mismatch, and post-layout effects
  • Design reviews are crisp: requirements, tradeoffs, and risks are clearly articulated and managed
  • Siliconbring-up converges quickly through strong correlation, structured debug, and decisive fixes
  • Cross-functional partners (layout, verification, test, validation) can execute efficiently with clear interfaces and documentation
  • Reusable design collateral and improvedmethodologyreduce cycle time and increase first-pass success

jobs.description:
About the Team

People love using HubSpot because it’s an essential product that gives them the tools and insights they need to grow their business. Trellis is HubSpot’s enterprise design system, the shared foundation that powers product surfaces across CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Commerce Hub, Breeze AI, and the growing portfolio of agentic experiences.

Trellis is not a style guide or a Figma library. It is the connective tissue between design intent and product reality at scale: a living system of tokens, components, patterns, documentation, and tooling that designers and engineers across HubSpot depend on every day to build with speed, quality, accessibility, and consistency.

We are at a defining inflection point. AI is fundamentally expanding what a design system needs to be. In the AI native era, Trellis must be machine readable as well as human readable. Tokens need semantic structure that AI tools can reason about. Components and patterns need usage guidance that helps teams make better decisions earlier. Documentation needs to serve the designer working in Figma, the engineer implementing in code, and the AI assisted tool generating product UI.

This is the environment you’re stepping into, and it is exactly the right moment to shape how HubSpot builds.

About this Role

We are hiring three Staff Product Designers to help shape the next phase of Trellis, HubSpot’s enterprise design system. These roles share the same broader mission: helping product teams across HubSpot build faster, more consistently, and with a higher quality bar as our platform becomes more connected, adaptive, and AI native.

Each role will focus on a different part of the system:

Tokens and Visual Language
This role owns the foundational visual system behind Trellis, including color, typography, spacing, iconography, motion, theming, density, semantic tokens, and the visual quality bar for how HubSpot shows up in product. This person will help evolve Trellis’ token architecture and visual language so it can scale across product surfaces, support AI assisted development, and remain coherent as the platform grows.

Components
This role owns the reusable building blocks product teams use every day, including component anatomy, behavior, variants, states, accessibility, documentation, implementation guidance, and Figma to code alignment. This person will help define what belongs in the shared system, how components should behave, and how Trellis can reduce fragmentation across teams without slowing product development.

Patterns
This role owns the repeatable product behaviors and interaction models that show up across HubSpot, such as creation, editing, filtering, search, object management, permissions, notifications, recommendations, and AI assisted workflows. This person will help product teams solve common problems in more consistent ways and make HubSpot feel more coherent across connected customer workflows.

Across all three roles, you’ll work at the intersection of product design, systems thinking, craft, engineering partnership, governance, adoption, documentation, and implementation quality. You will make decisions that affect many product teams and help define how a large B2B platform builds product in an AI native era.

This is not a role where you simply maintain what exists. Trellis is in a multi-year modernization journey, and this team is helping make the system trusted, self-serve, and useful in day-to-day product development. You will help reduce fragmentation, improve system adoption, shape contribution models, and create the shared foundations that let HubSpot build with more speed and quality at scale.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own and evolve a major focus area within Trellis, either Tokens and Visual Language, Components, or Patterns
  • Partner with product, engineering, content design, research, and design technology to define system guidance that is usable, scalable, accessible, and practical to implement
  • Make high-judgment system decisions that balance consistency, flexibility, accessibility, technical constraints, product team needs, and customer experience
  • Help reduce fragmentation across HubSpot by creating shared foundations that teams can trust, adopt, and contribute to
  • Improve alignment between Figma, documentation, and front-end implementation so Trellis becomes easier to use and harder to misuse
  • Define documentation and usage guidance that helps designers, engineers, and AI assisted tools understand how to apply the system correctly
  • Partner with product teams to understand adoption friction, edge cases, implementation gaps, and emerging needs
  • Contribute to governance and contribution models that allow Trellis to evolve without creating drift
  • Support accessibility, internationalization, responsive behavior, and implementation quality as core requirements of the system
  • Collaborate with design technologists and engineers on component APIs, design tokens, implementation fidelity, usage constraints, acceptance criteria, and system tooling
  • Hold a high quality bar for the system while building trust with teams across the organization
  • Help Trellis become more machine readable as well as human readable, so it can support AI coding tools, MCP integrations, and future generative UI workflows

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for systems-minded product designers who have worked at the scale where design systems become product infrastructure. You understand that enterprise design systems are not just libraries of reusable UI. They are operating systems for how teams build, adopt, govern, and evolve product experiences across a large platform.

You may come from a background in design systems, product foundations, platform design, visual systems, component libraries, interaction patterns, enterprise product design, developer tools, or complex B2B SaaS. You do not need to be equally deep in tokens, components, and patterns. We expect candidates to have a stronger spike in one area, but we are looking for designers who understand how the pieces connect.

You are comfortable moving between product strategy, detailed interaction design, system architecture, documentation, and cross-functional influence. You can zoom into the details of a component state, token decision, accessibility requirement, or interaction pattern, then zoom out to explain why it matters across the broader platform.

We’re especially interested in people who have:

  • Extensive experience with enterprise design systems or complex multi-product platforms, spanning governance, adoption, documentation, accessibility, contribution models, and cross-team influence — not just component creation
  • A strong spike in one or more areas: tokens and visual language, reusable components, product patterns, accessibility, documentation, governance, adoption, or Figma-to-code alignment
  • Deep experience in at least one of: enterprise SaaS, CRM, developer tools, commerce, data-heavy products, AI-assisted workflows, or other complex product environments
  • Experience designing reusable components across anatomy, states, variants, behaviors, accessibility, responsive rules, and implementation constraints
  • Experience owning visual foundations at scale — tokens, theming, color, typography, iconography, and motion
  • Strong engineering partnership on component APIs, tokens, documentation, implementation fidelity, and front-end architecture
  • A track record of improving adoption, contribution models, governance, migration, and team enablement
  • Staff-level autonomy: identifying the right problems, setting direction, influencing partners, and driving resolution without close oversight
  • Strong product craft with the ability to balance consistency, flexibility, usability, accessibility, and implementation reality
  • Curiosity and rigor around evolving design systems for AI-assisted product development
  • A portfolio showing system-level work — not isolated screens or visual explorations
  • Clear communication of system decisions to designers, engineers, product leaders, and non-specialist stakeholders

Position Summary

Ironmark is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to support franchisees and local operators participating in multi-location marketing programs. This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology. They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges.

The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships. They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership

The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations.

  • Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.
  • Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services.
  • Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.
  • Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment.
  • Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus

Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance

  • Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities.
  • Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management

  • Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs.
  • Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.
  • Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs.

Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance

  • Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.

  • Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness. They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. Email Marketing Specialist

Email Campaigns, Automation, Deliverability & Lifecycle Marketing | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Email Marketing Specialist to build, launch, and optimize high-performing email campaigns that drive engagement, nurture leads, and generate measurable business results.

This is a hands-on email marketing role combining:

  • Email campaign execution
  • Copywriting
  • Audience segmentation
  • Marketing automation
  • Lifecycle and nurture workflows
  • Email deliverability
  • A/B testing
  • Performance analytics

You’ll own the full email campaign lifecycle — from planning and segmentation through launch, deliverability monitoring, optimization, and reporting.

If you understand both the creative and technical sides of email marketing and enjoy using data to continuously improve performance, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Email Campaign Development & Execution

Build, launch, and manage campaigns using platforms such as:

  • HubSpot
  • Klaviyo
  • Marketo
  • Mailchimp
  • ActiveCampaign

You’ll:

  • Write compelling subject lines, email copy, and calls-to-action
  • Develop campaigns tailored to different audience segments and lifecycle stages
  • Build and optimize responsive email templates
  • Maintain consistency with brand guidelines and messaging
  • Perform basic HTML/CSS edits when needed
  • QA campaigns before launch to ensure links, formatting, personalization, and tracking work correctly

Audience Segmentation & List Management

Manage and maintain email databases ranging from 20,000 to 200,000+ contacts.

You’ll:

  • Segment audiences based on:
    • Lifecycle stage
    • Engagement
    • Persona
    • Geography
    • Behavioral data
    • Customer activity
  • Maintain clean and organized contact databases
  • Identify and remove:
    • Hard bounces
    • Inactive contacts
    • Duplicates
    • Spam traps
  • Improve personalization and targeting strategies
  • Maintain strong list hygiene to protect sender reputation and campaign performance

Marketing Automation & Nurture Workflows

Build and optimize automated email journeys including:

  • Lead nurture sequences
  • Drip campaigns
  • Onboarding workflows
  • Behavioral automations
  • Abandoned cart flows
  • Re-engagement campaigns
  • Lifecycle sequences

You’ll also:

  • Configure triggers, conditions, and branching logic
  • Test workflows before launch
  • Troubleshoot automation issues
  • Analyze performance across different stages of the journey
  • Continuously optimize sequences for engagement and conversion

Email Deliverability & Compliance

Monitor and improve:

  • Sender reputation
  • Inbox placement
  • Bounce rates
  • Spam complaints
  • Domain and email authentication
  • Overall deliverability

Work with configurations including:

  • SPF
  • DKIM
  • DNS
  • Suppression lists

Use tools such as:

  • Litmus
  • GlockApps
  • Postmark

Ensure email programs follow:

  • CAN-SPAM
  • GDPR
  • CCPA
  • Email marketing and permission best practices

Troubleshoot deliverability problems and implement solutions to protect long-term sender health.

A/B Testing & Performance Optimization

Develop structured tests across:

  • Subject lines
  • Email copy
  • CTAs
  • Send times
  • Layouts
  • Offers
  • Messaging
  • Audience segments

Use campaign data to identify opportunities to improve:

  • Engagement
  • Click-through rates
  • Conversions
  • Lead nurturing
  • Retention
  • Revenue contribution

Analytics & Reporting

Track email marketing KPIs including:

  • Open rates
  • Click-through rates
  • Conversion rates
  • Bounce rates
  • Unsubscribe rates
  • Engagement
  • Revenue attribution

Build and maintain reports using:

  • ESP analytics
  • Google Analytics
  • CRM reporting
  • Looker
  • Excel / Google Sheets

Translate campaign data into clear insights and optimization recommendations for leadership and marketing stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional email marketing experience
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major ESP:
    • HubSpot
    • Klaviyo
    • Marketo
    • Mailchimp
    • ActiveCampaign
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Email marketing automation
    • Audience segmentation
    • Lead nurturing
    • Lifecycle campaigns
    • List management
  • Experience building automated email workflows
  • Experience analyzing email campaign performance
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email template customization
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • VLOOKUP
    • Reporting
    • Data segmentation
  • Strong copywriting and written English skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing email databases of 50,000+ contacts
  • Experience with Litmus, GlockApps, Postmark, or similar deliverability tools
  • Hands-on knowledge of SPF, DKIM, DNS, and sender authentication
  • Experience integrating ESPs with Salesforce, HubSpot, or other CRM platforms
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Professional services
    • B2B marketing
  • Understanding of lifecycle and behavioral marketing
  • Experience with revenue attribution and funnel reporting

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Balance strong copywriting with analytical thinking
  • Understand that email performance goes beyond simply writing good copy
  • Know how segmentation, automation, deliverability, and data work together
  • Are comfortable troubleshooting technical email issues
  • Pay close attention to campaign details before hitting send
  • Enjoy testing ideas and using data to improve results
  • Can manage several campaigns and workflows simultaneously
  • Take ownership of performance rather than simply executing tasks

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Building and scheduling email campaigns
  • Writing subject lines, copy, and CTAs
  • Creating or modifying email templates
  • Segmenting audiences for upcoming campaigns
  • Reviewing database and list health
  • Building automated nurture sequences
  • Testing triggers and workflow logic
  • Monitoring deliverability and sender reputation
  • Reviewing campaign analytics
  • Launching A/B tests
  • Preparing performance reports
  • Sharing optimization recommendations with leadership

In short: you ensure email marketing campaigns are well-written, properly targeted, technically sound, automated effectively, and consistently optimized for engagement, conversions, and business growth.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Open rates meeting or exceeding relevant benchmarks
  • CTR of approximately 3–5%+ where appropriate
  • Improved campaign and workflow conversion rates
  • Bounce rate maintained below 2%
  • Unsubscribe rate maintained below 1%
  • Healthy sender reputation and inbox placement
  • Accurate campaign and revenue attribution
  • Improved lead nurturing and lifecycle engagement
  • Reliable campaign execution with minimal errors

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Ownership of the complete email marketing lifecycle
  • Blend of creative, analytical, and technical marketing
  • Hands-on experience with leading ESP and automation platforms
  • Direct impact on engagement, pipeline, retention, and revenue
  • Opportunity to build sophisticated lifecycle and nurture programs
  • Exposure to marketing analytics and deliverability strategy
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Lifecycle Marketing
    • Marketing Automation
    • CRM Marketing
    • Growth Marketing
    • Marketing Operations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Assessment — such as building a 3-email nurture workflow for a sample product launch
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

  • Have hands-on email marketing experience
  • Know platforms such as HubSpot, Klaviyo, Marketo, Mailchimp, or ActiveCampaign
  • Understand segmentation, automation, and deliverability
  • Can write compelling email copy
  • Enjoy testing and optimizing campaigns based on data
  • Want ownership over email performance from strategy through execution

We’d love to hear from you.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with email marketing platforms, campaign execution, automation workflows, audience segmentation, copywriting, deliverability, A/B testing, and performance optimization.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Vice President, Healthcare Innovations
jobs.excerpt: AIR is seeking an accomplished healthcare leader to serve as Vice President, Program Lead for the Healthcare Innovations (HI) Program.
jobs.description:
AIR is seeking an accomplished healthcare leader to serve as Vice President, Program Lead for the Healthcare Innovations (HI) Program. The HI Program brings together highly trained health economists, data scientists, and quantitative and qualitative researchers who evaluate and implement health care delivery and payment models, generate actionable evidence, and develop data-driven solutions that improve quality, access, patient experience, health outcomes, and affordability. The HI team partners with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Medicare Payment Advisory Commission (MedPAC), Medicaid and CHIP Payment Advisory Commission (MACPAC), and other public and private clients applying health economics, advanced analytics, and mixed methods.

Reporting to the Chief Program Officer, the HI Program Lead will be responsible for the people, projects, and pursuits within the HI Program, including talent development, quality assurance, the efficient operation of their team, client services, and business development. Program Leads are responsible for effectively leading staff and day-to-day operations, ensuring thought leadership, strong project performance on technical, budget, and client satisfaction dimensions, managing senior staff, and developing next-generation leaders. Program Leads identify mission-aligned business development opportunities to contribute to program growth, expand the depth and breadth of project work, and lead the efficient and successful pursuit of those opportunities. Program Leads are responsible for driving strong, consistent communication and coordination within their programs, with other programs in the Program Office and with other offices across the organization with a spirit of collaboration and transparency.

Program Leads develop the overall vision and strategic direction for the program and engage in planning and problem solving to help meet program goals, elevating the quality of the program leadership team’s strategic thinking, creativity, and innovation. The HI Program Lead will be a member of the Program Office Leadership Team, working in close collaboration with other Program Office leaders.

This position is based in the United States and the HI Program Lead must be able to travel as needed. The selected candidate may work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

  • Develops and implements new business plans and strategies in collaboration with the Chief Program Officer and Chief Growth Officer, identifies business development opportunities for the HI program, building a robust business pipeline in collaboration with other Program Leads and program staff.
  • Supports achievement of the Program Office financial goals and business development goals.
  • Leads the execution and management of the HI Program’s projects, people, and business pursuits.
  • Serves as subject matter expert in health economics, healthcare delivery and payment reform, Medicare / Medicaid policy, data analytics, and healthcare quality measurement.
  • Provides strategic leadership in design, implementation, and evaluation of healthcare delivery and payment models using rigorous quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods approaches.
  • Contributes to the development of operational plans and annual budgets for the Program Office in support of AIR’s overall strategic direction in collaboration with the Chief Program Officer. Implements budgets and plans for the HI Program.
  • Supports the achievement of the Program Office goals related to staff engagement and development and client satisfaction.
  • Leads staffing, workforce planning, and professional development efforts in the Program; implements strategies to attract, retain, and manage a cohesive and high-performing team.
  • Serves as a visible leader representing AIR with clients, partners, staff, and other stakeholders. Builds and maintains relationships with potential teaming partners, subcontractors, and subject matter consultants.
  • Helps establish and maintain broad and deep relationships with client organizations and becomes seen as a trusted advisor to clients. Maintains strong, trust-based relationships with CMS contracting officers, project officers, and program staff; anticipates client needs and proactively surfaces insights and solutions.
  • Works with Program Office leadership to develop a culture consistent with AIR's mission and values.
  • Enhances AIR’s external reputation in collaboration with the Communications and Public Affairs Office.

Qualifications, Experience and Attributes:

  • An advanced degree in Health Economics, Health Services Research, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 20 years of overall experience in designing, implementing, and evaluating health care delivery and payment programs and policies.
  • Minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Subject matter expertise in health economics and the implementation and evaluation of healthcare delivery and payment models, including experience with the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) models.
  • Proven track record of leading proposals, winning contract work, and managing and leading teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams of health economists, data scientists, quantitative researchers, and qualitative researchers in the execution of large-scale federal health projects.
  • Experience in designing and successfully leading multiple complex, innovative healthcare payment and delivery models projects.
  • Professional services industry knowledge with business development experience in federal and/or state government contracting, and/or with foundations.
  • Proven program leadership and high-level management experience, with a documented record of delivering results.
  • Excellent planning skills, analytic and process orientation, and a disciplined approach to managing programs.
  • Ability to demonstrate a commitment to both the institution’s mission and financial viability.
  • Experience developing and implementing strategic direction in a program and assessing progress and performance against defined objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop rapport with and lead mission-driven teams with both internal (staff) members and external (subcontractor and consultant) members.
  • Experience integrating teams and leading through times of transition.
  • Demonstrated commitment to support staff growth and creating leadership opportunities to staff at all levels of the organization.
  • Flexibility and ability to manage change and adapt to changing circumstances and needs.
  • Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to listen and understand concerns as well as the ability to communicate clearly with a variety of audiences, both internal and external.
  • Established reputation as a thought leader through publications, presentations, advisory roles, or other contributions to the healthcare policy and research community.

Disclosures: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. Employment-based visa sponsorship (including H-1B sponsorship) is not available for this position. Depending on project work, qualified candidates may need to meet certain residency requirements.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

At Reddit, machine learning sits at the heart of how millions of people discover, connect, and engage with the world’s largest collection of human conversations. From powering personalized recommendations and search to optimizing advertising systems and marketplace dynamics, our ML engineers tackle some of the most interesting and impactful problems in large-scale applied machine learning.

We hire Machine Learning Engineers across both our Consumer and Ads organizations, giving you the opportunity to work on a wide range of high-impact problems across the Reddit ecosystem.

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers who are excited to build systems end-to-end, from research and modeling to production deployment, — and who want to help shape the future of discovery, relevance, and monetization at Reddit.

If you love working on complex, real-world ML problems at massive scale, this role is for you.

What You’ll Work On

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Reddit, you will design and build production ML systems that power core experiences across the platform, including:

  • Personalized recommendations, search, and ranking systems that help users discover the most relevant content and communities
  • Intelligent advertising systems including ranking, bidding, measurement, and optimization
  • Content, Advertisers, and User understanding, from building foundational content/user representations to deriving insightful signals
  • Large-scale machine learning pipelines, model serving infrastructure, and real-time decision systems
  • Applied AI and LLM-driven experiences that improve relevance, discovery, and user engagement

You’ll work on high-impact systems that operate at internet scale and directly influence user experience, advertiser value, and business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade machine learning models and systems at scale
  • Own the full ML lifecycle: from problem definition and feature engineering to training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring
  • Build scalable data and model pipelines with strong reliability, observability, and automated retraining
  • Work with large-scale datasets to improve ranking, recommendations, search relevance, prediction, content/user understanding, and optimization systems.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to translate complex problems into ML solutions
  • Improve system performance across latency, throughput, and model quality metrics
  • Research and apply state-of-the-art machine learning and AI techniques, including deep learning, graph & transformers based, and LLM evaluation/alignment
  • Contribute to technical strategy, architecture, and long-term ML roadmap

Basic Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years of experience building, deploying, and operating machine learning systems in production
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Go, or similar languages, with solid software engineering fundamentals
  • ML Fundamentals: a strong grasp of algorithms, from classic statistical learning (XGBoost, Random Forests, regressions) to DL architectures (Transformers, CNNs, GNNs)
  • Hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Experience designing scalable ML pipelines, data processing systems, and model serving infrastructure
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and translate ambiguous product or business problems into technical solutions
  • Experience improving measurable metrics through applied machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with recommender systems, search/ranking systems, advertising/auction systems, large-scale representation learning, or multimodal embedding systems
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale data processing (Spark, Kafka, Ray, Airflow, BigQuery, Redis, etc.)
  • Experience working with real-time systems and low-latency production environments
  • Background in feature engineering, model optimization, and production monitoring
  • Experience with LLM/Gen AI techniques, including but not limited to LLM evaluation, alignment, fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, RAG/agentic systems and productionizing LLM-powered products at scale
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related quantitative field

Potential Teams

jobs.title: Arquitecto/a de Soluciones — Legacy & Migración a AWS
jobs.excerpt: Sobre CoderioCoderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales.
jobs.description:
Sobre Coderio

Coderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales. Con una base técnica sólida y una mentalidad orientada al producto, nuestros equipos lideran proyectos de software complejos desde la arquitectura hasta la ejecución. Valoramos la autonomía, la comunicación clara y la excelencia técnica. Colaboramos estrechamente con equipos y socios internacionales, construyendo tecnología que genera impacto.

Más información:

En este puesto, te incorporarás al equipo de Arquitectura, haciéndote cargo del dominio legacy de la compañía y liderando su evolución. Hoy todo el legacy corre sobre GCP: cargas desplegadas en Kubernetes (GKE) y mensajería basada en Pub/Sub. En paralelo, la compañía está consolidando su plataforma event-driven sobre AWS.

Tu misión tendrá tres frentes simultáneos: mitigar los riesgos operativos y técnicos del legacy actual, mejorar lo que debe seguir vivo mientras dure la transición, y diseñar y conducir la migración progresiva de esas cargas hacia AWS. Es un rol técnico y estratégico a la vez: no solo diseñarás, sino que entenderás el negocio detrás de cada sistema legacy para decidir qué se migra, qué se refactoriza, qué se retira y en qué orden.

Lo que puedes esperar de este rol (Responsabilidades)

  • Entender el negocio: mapear los sistemas legacy a las capacidades de negocio que soportan, identificar dependencias críticas y traducir necesidades de negocio en decisiones de arquitectura.
  • Mitigación: identificar y reducir riesgos del legacy actual sobre GCP (deuda técnica, puntos únicos de falla, brechas de seguridad, costos, observabilidad).
  • Mejoras: priorizar y diseñar mejoras incrementales sobre lo que debe seguir operando durante la transición, sin frenar el negocio.
  • Migración a AWS: definir la estrategia y el roadmap de migración desde GCP (GKE + Pub/Sub) hacia AWS (EKS/Lambda, SNS/SQS/EventBridge), eligiendo el patrón adecuado por sistema (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire).
  • Diseñar arquitecturas de destino alineadas a los estándares de plataforma event-driven (contratos de eventos versionados, mínimo privilegio, infraestructura como código).
  • Redactar y sostener ADRs, diagramas y documentación de decisiones; comunicar trade-offs a stakeholders técnicos y de negocio.
  • Acompañar a los equipos de desarrollo en la ejecución, revisando diseños e implementaciones.
  • Gestionar la convivencia temporal de ambos mundos (GCP ↔ AWS) durante la migración: interoperabilidad de eventos, autenticación entre nubes, doble escritura/lectura cuando aplique.

Requisitos

  • 6+ años en desarrollo/ingeniería de software, con 3+ años en roles de arquitectura o liderazgo técnico (Excluyente).
  • Experiencia comprobable liderando migraciones cloud o modernización de sistemas legacy, idealmente entre nubes o de on-prem a cloud (Excluyente).
  • Dominio sólido de GCP: GKE (Kubernetes) y Pub/Sub — capacidad de entender y diagnosticar el legacy actual.
  • Dominio sólido de AWS y sus servicios de mensajería y cómputo: SNS, SQS, EventBridge, Lambda, EKS, S3, IAM.
  • Experiencia diseñando arquitecturas orientadas a eventos y sistemas distribuidos: idempotencia, entrega at-least-once, ordenamiento, resiliencia.
  • Kubernetes a nivel de diseño y operación (GKE y/o EKS).
  • Infraestructura como código (Terraform) y disciplina de IAM con mínimo privilegio.
  • Capacidad demostrada de entender el dominio de negocio y traducirlo a decisiones arquitectónicas, no solo criterio técnico.
  • Sólida comunicación y cultura de documentación (ADRs, diagramas, roadmaps).
  • Certificación AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (o superior) vigente (Excluyente).
  • Español profesional; inglés técnico fluido.

Deseable

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional y/o certificaciones equivalentes en GCP (Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Experiencia en fintech o entornos regulados (SBS, CCE, CCI en Perú).
  • Conocimiento de CloudEvents, schema registries y gobernanza de eventos.
  • Experiencia con autenticación híbrida entre nubes (WIF, OIDC, federación de identidades GCP↔AWS).
  • Observabilidad y tracing distribuido en entornos multi-cloud.
  • Manejo de datos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, BigQuery) y estrategias de migración de datos.
  • Experiencia liderando o mentoreando equipos de desarrollo.

Beneficios

  • Compromiso a largo plazo, con autonomía e impacto.
  • Rol estratégico y de alta visibilidad sobre un dominio complejo y transversal.
  • Equipo internacional colaborativo y liderazgo técnico sólido.
  • Plan de carrera, crecimiento y liderazgo dentro de Coderio.

¿Por qué unirte a Coderio?

En Coderio valoramos el talento sin importar la ubicación. Somos una empresa remote-first, apasionada por la tecnología, el trabajo colaborativo y la compensación justa. Ofrecemos un entorno inclusivo, desafiante y con oportunidades reales de crecimiento.

Si te motiva construir soluciones con impacto, te estamos esperando. Postula ahora.

jobs.excerpt: Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together Our Meaningful Mission At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates.
jobs.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together

Our Meaningful Mission

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech.

Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By

Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
Velocity:We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. Our remote-first culture means you have the flexibility to work in your employing country wherever you feel the most focused and productive. This freedom comes with wonderful tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. Think unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

About the role and team

The Director of Fincrime Operations Excellence is being hired to transform how Fincrime operations are run. This is not a role for someone who maintains and iterates. This is a role for someone who walks into a gap, diagnoses what is missing, designs the solution, and drives it to completion, while simultaneously keeping the operation running. You will be accountable for queue health, analyst productivity, and the case management system that underpins all Fincrime control execution.

You will report directly to the Sr. Director of Fincrime Product, sit alongside Product Managers, and manage direct reports. You will work across a globally distributed team and are expected to operate flexibly across time zones. This may include early morning or late evening calls with APAC, to ensure the operation functions without gaps in coverage or leadership.

What you will focus on

Build the operational framework from scratch
  • Conduct a rapid assessment of the current operational state: what processes exist, what is undocumented, where quality is inconsistent, and where there are no standards at all.
  • Design and implement a complete set of standard operating procedures covering alert triage, to drafting investigation summary that can be used for regulatory reporting, and queue management
  • Establish escalation paths, handoff protocols, and coverage models that work across a globally distributed team and multiple time zones.
  • Create the governance cadence i.e.daily stand-ups, weekly queue reviews, monthly quality reviews that keeps the operation running and productivity visible to leadership.
  • Your mandate is to build an end-to-end operational infrastructure — queue management, productivity standards, quality frameworks, case management ownership, and standard operating procedures.

Stand up queue management and productivity standards
  • Define what good queue health looks like: target SLAs, acceptable thresholds for triggering backlog review and prioritization.
  • Implement real-time queue monitoring dashboard to monitor productivity.
  • Establish performance metrics.
  • Design and own the capacity model to forecast staffing requirements
  • Build a productivity improvement program: identify the top bottlenecks in operations workflow, prioritize fixes, and track improvement over time.

Own the case management system
  • Take ownership of the case management platform used by Fincrime operations analysts.
  • Work with the Product to define the product roadmap for the case management tool, based on operational pain points and efficiency opportunities you identify.
  • Ensure the case management system produces a complete, auditable record of every analyst decision. Data quality of the system is your accountability.
  • Define and enforce the data entry standards and workflow discipline that make the system reliable for QA sampling, regulatory reporting, and management information.

Build and own the quality framework
  • Design and own the quality control and quality assurance framework — defining the standards, scoring rubric, sampling methodology, CAPA process, and reporting cadence that govern how Fincrime control execution is assessed. This framework is yours to create; the QC/QA Manager is accountable for executing it once built.
  • Stand up an independent QA programme: sampling methodology, scoring rubric, reporting cadence, and CAPA process.
  • Establish error rate baselines across all control types, set improvement targets, and track progress monthly.
  • Ensure the quality framework is recognised by the compliance function as credible evidence of control execution standards.

Global coverage and timezone management
  • Ensure the operation has leadership coverage across all active time zones — designing shift structures, handoff protocols, and async communication norms for a globally distributed team.
  • Be personally available for escalations and critical decisions outside standard business hours when required, and model the timezone flexibility you expect from the team.
  • Build an operation that does not depend on any single timezone's working hours to function.

Ongoing operational accountability
  • Own queue health across all Fincrime control types — TM alerts, screening hits, CRR reviews, SAR pipeline — ensuring SLAs are met consistently.
  • Report operational performance monthly to the Sr. Director and compliance stakeholders, with clear narrative on variances and remediation plans.
  • Act as the primary operational voice in the fortnightly Fincrime Product Review and serve as the senior escalation point for operational issues.
  • Interface with the compliance function on quality findings, regulatory examination readiness, and control attestation.

What you bring to the table
  • 5+ years in operations management, specifically within a high-growth fintech or regulated financial environment.
  • A history of architecting operational foundations, including establishing quality control framework and SOPs, from the ground up.
  • Proven track record of identifying gaps/improvements and driving implementation.
  • Direct involvement in influencing internal tools to drive efficiency.
  • Experience managing globally distributed teams, working flexibly across multiple timezones,
  • Strong knowledge of AML controls across customer risk rating, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and fraud detection.
  • You are motivated by the challenge of establishing order and clarity in an unstructured environment.
  • Strong analytical and diagnostic skills to evaluate operational health rapidly and prioritize high-impact solutions for critical gaps.
  • Clear and structured communicator, capable of building alignment between product teams, operations, and compliance leadership.
  • Data proficiency, with the ability to establish key metrics and derive actionable insights from complex quality and operational datasets.

Nice to have / Bonus Points if you have
  • Proven background within a large-scale fintech operation.
  • Familiarity with the financial crime tech landscape, including screening vendors, transaction monitoring rules, and case management systems.
  • Direct experience managing complex operations across the Americas, APAC, and EMEA regions concurrently.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

jobs.excerpt: Current Employees:If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process.
jobs.description:
Current Employees:

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

The Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) Second Level Reviewer performs high-level, complex, secondary case reviews to facilitate and obtain appropriate provider documentation for clinical conditions or procedures to reflect severity of illness, expected risk of mortality, accuracy of patient outcomes, and complexity of patient care. Serves as key resource for CDI/Coding/Quality. The CDI Second Level Reviewer works in collaboration with CDI & quality leadership, CDI specialists, coders, quality analysts, providers, and other members of the healthcare team to ensure accurate, high-quality clinical documentation to support UHealth initiatives. Adheres to departmental and organizational goals, objectives, standards of performance, policies and procedures, continually ensuring quality documentation and regulatory compliance.

1. Ensures accuracy, completeness, and quality of clinical information used for measuring and reporting physician and hospital outcomes.
2. Performs high-level, complex, timely secondary case reviews concurrently and retrospectively to identify potential gaps or opportunities to facilitate improved provider documentation.
3. Ensure clinical documentation accurately reflects the level of care rendered, severity of illness, risk of mortality, and clinical validation (in compliance with government and other regulations).
4. Applies advanced knowledge of CMS star rating, Vizient, and US News and World Report risk-adjustment systems to identify clinical documentation improvement opportunities.
5. Completes quality reviews focused on CDI quality elements, such as Mortality, Hospital Acquired Conditions (HAC), and other publicly reported patient quality or safety metrics (i.e. AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators).
6. Identify trends and key areas for improvement in querying, coding, and documentation integrity.
7. Demonstrates proficiency with ICD-10-CM/PCS, APR DRG, and MS DRG by providing information regarding clinical documentation opportunities, coding and DRG issues, as well as performance improvement methodologies.
8. Recognizes opportunities for documentation improvement using strong critical-thinking skills and sound judgment in decision making, keeping integrity and compliance at the forefront of considerations in addition to outcomes, reimbursement, and regulatory requirements.
9. Facilitates high-quality documentation by utilizing queries that are effective, clear, concise, and compliant in accordance with latest AHIMA/ACDIS Query Practice Brief.
10. Makes recommendation of possible refinement of principal diagnosis, secondary diagnoses, and/or procedures based on clinical data to facilitate appropriate DRG assignment.
11. Records review findings and other data elements accurately into CDI Software and other data mechanisms to support data integrity for reporting.
12. Effectively and appropriately communicates and collaborates with providers, HIM/coding, quality, CDI, and other members of the healthcare team.
13. Assists with concurrent and retrospective CDI case reviews, quality audits, and education as deemed necessary by CDI Leadership.
14. Works independently; demonstrates effective time management and prioritization of tasks.
15. Participates in meetings, including providing feedback and identifying trends and opportunities, presentations for educational opportunities, and any other needs identified by the CDI leaders.
16. Assumes responsibility for professional development through participation at workshops, conferences, and/or in-services and maintains appropriate records of participation.
17. Participates in departmental and organization projects, task forces, and/or committees as needed.
18. Complies with and ensures adherence to HIPAA and Code of Conduct policies.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.

Education:
Four (4) Year/bachelor’s degree required; BSN/BS/BA in related field Required; Graduate degree in Healthcare Administration, Informatics, Nursing, Leadership, Education or related field preferred.

Certification and Licensing:
Current RN or MD required; CCDS or CDIP certification required; Coding certification (CCS, CIC, or CPC) preferred.

Experience:
At least three (3) years recent inpatient clinical documentation improvement (CDI) experience required.
Demonstrated extensive clinical knowledge, critical-thinking skills, and understanding of disease processes, pathophysiology, and disease management/treatment required.
At least three (3) years of direct patient care clinical experience in hospital setting preferred.
Proficiency with ICD-10-CM/PCS, APR DRG, and MS DRG required.
At least one (1) year experience with mortality, PSI, HAC, or other quality-focused reviews required.
Knowledge of Vizient, Premier, US News and World Report, CMS star rating or similar risk-adjustment methodologies highly preferred.
Prior experience in an academic medical center (AMC) or large health system preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) required.
Proficiency with CDI software and encoder required. Experience with 3M 360 Encompass preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write concisely and effectively when communicating with providers.

The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more.

UHealth-University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. As an academic medical center, we are proud to serve South Florida, Latin America and the Caribbean. Our physicians represent more than 100 specialties and sub-specialties, and have more than one million patient encounters each year. Our tradition of excellence has earned worldwide recognition for outstanding teaching, research and patient care. We're the challenge you've been looking for.
