Sales Play Manager, Revenue Operations

Location: Remote, United States

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Sales Play Manager to join our growing team in a newly created role focused on Sales Plays execution. This position is critical to the success of our go-to-market strategy, partnering closely with GTM leadership, Sales, Marketing, and Field Enablement teams to design, launch, and optimize Sales Plays that drive revenue growth.

As the Sales Play Manager, you will own the end-to-end execution of Sales Plays, from data sourcing and account matching through launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role requiring strong technical skills in Salesforce, sales cadencing tools, and Excel, combined with excellent communication, problem-solving abilities, and a self-starter mentality. You'll be working in a dynamic, evolving program where adaptability and attention to detail are essential. As a member of our growing Revenue Operations team, there will be opportunities to expand your skills and grow within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Play Execution & Data Management

  • Build and manage target account lists based on propensity-to-buy attributes including industry, annual revenue, customer status, geographic territory, and other segmentation criteria
  • Identify existing Leads and Contacts to target within Sales Plays and source additional contacts using tools such as ZoomInfo and Cognism
  • Perform advanced data matching to align companies from external sources with existing Salesforce Accounts using data matching methodologies
  • Partner with SFDC Administrators to execute bulk uploads of new Accounts, Contacts, and Leads, ensuring data quality, required field population, and adherence to validation rules
  • Add prospects to the appropriate sales cadencing tool (High Velocity Sales/Salesforce Sales Engagement, SalesLoft, or Outreach.io) with proper assignee and engagement allocation
  • Validate and scrub all data against suppression lists (opt-outs, competitors, do-not-contact) and ensure compliance with data quality standards before loading into Salesforce

Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment

  • Collaborate with GTM Leadership to define Sales Play participants, territory assignments, and ownership structures; facilitate Sales leadership reviews to resolve ownership conflicts and finalize account assignments
  • Partner with Marketing and Field Enablement teams to align on lead intake processes, campaign associations, and play timing
  • Train GTM teams on leveraging tools involved in Sales Plays, including cadencing platforms, Salesforce reporting, and play-specific processes
  • Proactively communicate timelines, dependencies, and resource requirements to stakeholders; drive accountability to ensure plays launch on schedule

Monitoring, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for active Sales Plays, including engagement rates, conversion metrics, pipeline impact, and seller activity
  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards to track play performance and provide visibility to stakeholders
  • Own play performance reporting and share insights with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders based on data analysis, seller feedback, and data quality observations
  • Participate in post-play retrospectives to capture lessons learned and drive incremental improvements to the Sales Play process
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations peers to maintain and update Sales Play process documentation, including standard operating procedures, lessons learned, and best practices

Data Governance & Quality Assurance

  • Own data quality standards for Sales Plays, ensuring all records meet required field criteria, suppression list validations, and formatting consistency
  • Identify and resolve data load errors immediately post-execution; troubleshoot assignment failures, routing errors, and validation rule issues
  • Maintain suppression lists and manage data enrichment workflows to ensure compliance and data accuracy across all plays

Qualifications

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2-4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or related GTM operations role; OR experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR/BDR) with hands-on prospecting, list-building, and cadencing tool experience
  • Experience working in mid-sized B2B environments preferred; must be comfortable learning and navigating complex organizational structures, including sales territories, routing logic, and GTM team hierarchies
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce architecture and data model; advanced permissions and data access experience strongly preferred
  • Advanced Salesforce reporting skills, including building complex reports and dashboards; familiarity with filters, formulas, and cross-object reporting
  • Hands-on experience using sales cadencing tools such as High Velocity Sales (Salesforce Sales Engagement), SalesLoft, or Outreach.io to enroll prospects and manage multi-touch campaigns
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas (XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, CONCATENATE), data manipulation, text-to-columns, pivot tables, and combining large datasets from multiple sources
  • Experience using contact sourcing tools such as ZoomInfo, Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar data enrichment platforms
  • Understanding of GTM team structures, sales territories, and ownership models; experience working with or supporting sales teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience training or enabling sales or operations teams on tools and processes

Key Competencies

  • Self-starter with strong ownership mentality and ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills and resourcefulness; able to troubleshoot technical issues and identify creative solutions
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; comfortable asking clarifying questions and engaging with stakeholders at all levels
  • Highly organized and task-oriented with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguity; this is a new program with evolving requirements, and flexibility is essential
  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on partnership and driving cross-functional alignment
  • Process-oriented with experience documenting workflows and contributing to operational excellence

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with advanced Salesforce permissions, data access, and configuration
  • Experience with Pardot or other marketing automation platforms and lead management workflows
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Data Loader, DemandTools, or similar bulk data import/export tools
  • Understanding of lead routing, assignment rules, queues, and territory management within Salesforce
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services industries
  • Exposure to account-based marketing (ABM) or account-based sales strategies

This is an exciting opportunity to build and shape a new program from the ground up within a growing Revenue Operations team. If you're passionate about revenue operations, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to make a measurable impact on GTM success, we'd love to hear from you.

About Convera

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. We provide tech-led payment solutions to help more than 26,000 customers globally grow with confidence, from small businesses to CFOs and treasurers. As experts in foreign exchange, risk and compliance, with an unrivaled regulatory footprint, Convera’s financial network spans more than 140 currencies and 200 countries and territories.
Our teams care deeply about the value we deliver to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we expand our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment.

jobs.description:
About Laivly

Seeking curious and creative types! We are an ambitious company of innovators building and shaping the future of customer service technology. Our solutions help the world’s biggest brands leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital automation in their contact centers to deliver better customer experiences. Led by a team of established contact center experts, Laivly addresses the unique needs and challenges of customer service programs, with an emphasis on ethics in AI and the customer service agent experience.

About the role

The team at Laivly is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to help design, operate, and continuously improve the cloud infrastructure behind our technology.

As Senior Cloud Engineer, you’ll be a senior individual contributor focused on building secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-efficient AWS environments. You’ll combine deep hands-on cloud expertise with a reliability mindset, helping us strengthen our infrastructure, anticipate failure, improve observability, and turn operational challenges into lasting improvements.

Working closely with our Architecture, IT Operations, Information Security, and Engineering teams, you’ll have the opportunity to influence how our cloud environment evolves as Laivly continues to scale.

This position is remote and open to candidates within Canada.

As Senior Cloud Engineer, you will…

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Design, operate, and evolve secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient AWS environments, including compute, storage, databases, networking, identity, and shared cloud services.
  • Build and improve infrastructure-as-code standards, reusable architectures, configuration baselines, account structures, tagging, and lifecycle practices.
  • Lead cloud infrastructure migrations, modernization initiatives, and technical-debt reduction from planning through stable operation.

Reliability & Resilience

  • Strengthen cloud reliability through SLOs and SLIs, capacity planning, resilience testing, and proactive identification of infrastructure risks.
  • Design and test backup, disaster recovery, and multi-AZ or multi-region strategies appropriate to business requirements.
  • Identify systemic risks and drive improvements before they impact our customers or teams.

Observability & Operational Excellence

  • Build actionable observability across metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, and runbooks using Datadog and AWS-native services.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents, helping coordinate recovery, identify root causes, and drive lasting corrective actions.
  • Reduce operational toil through automation, tooling, clear procedures, and continuous improvements to detection, response, and recovery.

Security, Governance & Cloud Optimization

  • Partner with Security and Architecture to strengthen IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and cloud guardrails.
  • Support cloud governance across accounts, policies, auditability, asset inventory, and compliance practices.
  • Optimize cloud consumption and capacity through FinOps practices, forecasting, cost allocation, rightsizing, and Savings Plans.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, infrastructure standards, documentation, and mentorship.
  • Partner with application and engineering teams on infrastructure readiness, safe operational changes, and reliability improvements.
  • Translate business and engineering requirements into practical cloud solutions, clearly communicating risks, trade-offs, dependencies, and recommended investments.

As Senior Cloud Engineer, you have…

  • 5+ years of progressive hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, systems engineering, or platform engineering, with significant hands-on experience operating production AWS environments.
  • Strong AWS expertise across IAM, VPC networking, compute, storage, managed databases, load balancing, DNS, monitoring, and backup/disaster-recovery services.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, ideally Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, including modular design, state management, code review, and policy guardrails.
  • Experience applying reliability engineering practices, including SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, observability, incident command, root-cause analysis, post-incident learning, and resilience testing.
  • Strong cloud networking and security knowledge, including DNS, routing, connectivity, security groups/firewalls, identity federation, encryption, secrets, and least-privilege access.
  • Experience working with containers and Kubernetes/EKS, including cluster infrastructure, resource management, scaling, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in scripting or automation (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and comfort using APIs and version control to manage infrastructure safely.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices, including tagging, rightsizing, reservations/savings plans, cost allocation, and capacity forecasting.
  • Strong systems-thinking and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • An AWS certification such as Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Security Specialty is an asset.

Life at Laivly

Laivly gives you the opportunity to collaborate and grow your career with a creative, diverse, and passionate team. We work hard and play often, with a flexible environment that works with you. A career at Laivly means being part of a fun-loving, dedicated team of creatives, risk takers and game changers. It’s about sharing your talent and imagination to develop innovative tech that’s revolutionizing the way top brands interact with the world.

We’ve got a shared mission - and a Laivly future. Join us today!

jobs.description:
Requisition ID

2026-4588

Job Summary

Subject Matter Expert, Change Management

Client: Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration, Office of Clinical Informatics

Location: Remote, with occasional travel as required

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Tier 1 / Public Trust background investigation

Employment Type: Full time, contingent on contract award

Position Summary

The Subject Matter Expert, Change Implementation supports VHA in putting organizational change into practice. VHA is changing how clinical and administrative staff carry out their work. This position determines what those changes mean for the people doing the work and what it will take to prepare them.

The work begins with analysis. The SME identifies who a change affects, at what sites, in what roles, and how their day-to-day work will differ afterward. This includes changes to workflows, handoffs between teams, role responsibilities, and the systems staff use. The analysis also accounts for what those groups already have underway, since most sites are absorbing several changes at once.

The SME then builds the implementation plan. The plan covers what must happen before the change, what happens during, and what support staff need afterward. It addresses readiness activities, training needs, communication, and the measures used to determine whether adoption is working. The SME also identifies the risks the change creates, both to the program and to the people affected, and raises them to leadership early enough to act on.

Much of the role is spent working directly with people. The SME engages clinical and operational leaders at medical centers and program offices, along with training, communications, and informatics staff on the contract. Some of that engagement builds support for the change.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct stakeholder analyses to identify who is affected by a change, what they need, and who has influence over adoption.
  • Conduct impact analyses covering changes to workflows, roles, processes, and systems.
  • Build implementation plans, including sequencing, readiness activities, and what has to happen before, during, and after a change.
  • Identify risks created by change activities and flag them to program leadership.
  • Develop change and communication materials such as readiness assessments, communication plans, roadmaps, training plans, and resistance management plans.
  • Work with clinical and operational leaders to build support for the change and address pushback.
  • Track adoption and readiness, and report progress to the program and the customer.
  • Coordinate with training, communications, and informatics staff so change activities line up with delivery timelines.
  • Contribute change management content to program reports and deliverables.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree.
  • Ten (10) years of relevant work experience.
  • Experience leading organizational change efforts in large or complex organizations.
  • Experience conducting stakeholder analyses, impact analyses, and implementation planning.
  • Experience identifying and reporting risks tied to organizational change.
  • Experience briefing and working with senior leaders.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required VA background investigation.

The Field & Partner Marketing Manager is a self-starting marketer who partners closely with channel partners, channel sales, marketing, and leadership cross-functionally to drive the strategy and execution plan for programs and initiatives that gain partner mindshare, generate partner demand, recruit new partners, enhance the partner experience, and build pipeline and sales opportunities.

You’ll be responsible for making Arctic Wolf stand out in a creative and impactful way to stay top of mind with our most productive partners. Additionally, you’ll be responsible for digging into program performance data to identify trends, make recommendations and shape budget allocations that drive business results.

The ideal candidate Is a self-starter with a service attitude who has exceptional communication and writing skills, a partner-first attitude, and ability to create and launch high-impact programs that yield measurable results.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull and review reports, extract actionable insights and make recommendations; demonstrated ability to incorporate metrics into a process of continuous improvement

  • Excellent and polished interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral

  • Manage and report on budget; prioritize spend based on business need and performance data

  • Fully adept in tech stack required to generate and deploy campaigns and measure effectiveness including marketing automation, CRM and PRM

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Commerce Platform organization at Instacart is seeking an experienced Staff Software Engineer to lead foundational platform initiatives on the Orders Platform team. The Orders platform is the orchestration layer for commerce at Instacart, coordinating the end-to-end lifecycle of every order across customers, shoppers, retailers, payments, fulfillment systems, and partner integrations at scale.

In this role, you will help define and drive the architectural strategy for systems that support hundreds of millions of transactions each year. You will work on the reliability, correctness, scalability, and auditability of order workflows across diverse use cases and fulfillment models, while unlocking new experiences for customers, shoppers, retailers, and partners.

The Orders Platform team sits at the center of Instacart’s commerce stack, which means this role requires deep technical judgment, strong cross-functional partnership, and a willingness to solve complex problems across many domains. If you are a big-picture thinker who enjoys owning high-impact systems, leading multi-team initiatives, and building durable platforms that help teams move faster and more safely, this role is for you.

Instacart is a collaborative, fast-paced environment where engineers are encouraged to act like owners, communicate transparently, and build solutions that help the broader ecosystem succeed. You will partner with teams across Engineering, Product, Data, Infrastructure, and business functions to deliver platform capabilities that can scale with Instacart’s evolving commerce experiences.

About the Job

  • Lead multi-team initiatives that improve the reliability, scalability, and correctness of the Orders platform across checkout, payments, fulfillment, post-order workflows, and partner integrations.
  • Define and drive the technical strategy for the order lifecycle, including modeling and evolving order state machines, guarantees, and service contracts to support new products, fulfillment models, and surfaces while maintaining strong service expectations and data integrity.
  • Architect and evolve event-driven, idempotent workflows for core order flows such as creation, updates, cancellations, substitutions, payments, and refunds, ensuring clear invariants, observability, and auditable histories across services.
  • Partner closely with engineering and cross-functional teams across Payments, Fulfillment, Catalog, Ads, Fraud and Identity, Data, and Infrastructure to deliver durable platform capabilities that other product teams can build on safely and quickly.
  • Modernize and extend the platform through capabilities such as improved consistency models, multi-tenant abstractions, stronger failure isolation, and secure integrations that increase flexibility and operability at scale.
  • Design platform capabilities that support agentic commerce, including policy-driven automated workflows, secure APIs, and well-defined tools that make Orders safely addressable by agents and AI systems.
  • Raise the technical bar by leading design reviews, coaching engineers, contributing hands-on to critical code paths, and helping teams make sound technical decisions through design spikes, launches, and cross-team efforts.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience designing, developing, and operating large-scale backend or platform systems in production environments.
  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technical initiatives end to end, including architecture, implementation, rollout, and ongoing operations.
  • Strong foundation in distributed systems, service-oriented architectures, and high-volume APIs, including hands-on experience with event-driven patterns and idempotent workflows.
  • Proficiency in one or more backend programming languages such as Go, Java, or Python.
  • Production experience with relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Experience operating mission-critical services, including on-call ownership, service-level objectives or error budgets, performance tuning, incident management, and post-incident reviews.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate design exploration, implementation, code review, or code quality.
  • Strong communication skills with experience partnering effectively with senior engineers, Product, and cross-functional stakeholders to align on technical direction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience building payments, orders, logistics, or other high-integrity transactional platforms, including policy-driven entitlements and consistency or availability trade-offs.
  • Deep expertise with asynchronous workflows and event-driven architectures such as Kafka or Pub/Sub, including at-least-once or exactly-once processing and outbox patterns.
  • Experience integrating with diverse internal services and external partners, with clear ownership of API contracts, data models, service expectations, and operational readiness.
  • Success building or evolving multi-tenant, extensible platforms that enable rapid onboarding of new product flows, payment methods, incentive types, or partner integrations.
  • Strong observability and reliability engineering practices, including tracing, metrics, alerting, circuit breaking, and chaos testing.
  • Experience with secure-by-default service design, including tokenization, secrets management, PCI considerations, or PII considerations.
  • Interest in applying AI and agentic patterns to platform engineering work in a safe, reliable, and measurable way.

You’ll work closely with analysts, senior bankers, clients, lawyers, accountants, and advisors to ensure transactions move forward accurately and on schedule.

Financial Modeling & Valuation

Research & Analysis

  • Prepare briefing notes and strategic insights
  • Incorporate research findings into valuation assumptions and transaction materials

Analyst Review & Senior Banker Support

  • Review analyst work for accuracy, consistency, and presentation quality

Compliance & Documentation

As an Enterprise Sales Manager you will own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise grocery retailers and co-pilot the end-to-end commercial strategy for Storefront Pro adoption. Alongside cross-functional Business Development retail account owners, you'll be collaborating on new logo acquisition within the context of Storefront Pro.

This role carries significant upside as Storefront Pro continues to scale as the lead enterprise solution for Instacart.   • Serve as a critical feedback channel between the field and internal teams — translating retailer objections, competitive dynamics, and market signals into actionable product and GTM recommendations

About You

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage full-cycle recruiting across sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate management, and offer coordination.

This is a fast-paced, execution-focused recruiting role for someone who knows how to find strong candidates, evaluate talent effectively, and keep multiple hiring pipelines moving at the same time.

Offer Management & Onboarding Support

  • Support compensation discussions and negotiations
  • Maintain candidate engagement through acceptance

Recruiting Operations & Reporting

  • Greenhouse
  • Lever
  • JazzHR
  • iCIMS

Track recruiting KPIs including:

  • Time-to-fill
  • Source effectiveness
  • Candidate pipeline health
  • Interview conversion rates
  • Offer acceptance
  • Hiring progress

Ensure ATS records, candidate notes, and pipeline stages remain accurate and up to date.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience managing multiple open roles simultaneously
  • Strong hands-on candidate sourcing experience
  • Experience conducting recruiter screens and structured interviews
  • Ability to manage candidates throughout the complete recruiting lifecycle

Sourcing Skills

Strong experience with:

  • Boolean search
  • Job boards
  • Passive candidate sourcing
  • Candidate outreach
  • Talent pipeline development

ATS & Recruiting Technology

Hands-on experience with ATS platforms such as:

  • Lever
  • JazzHR
  • iCIMS
  • Or similar recruiting systems

Communication & Organization

  • Excellent written and verbal English
  • Strong candidate communication skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Excellent organization and follow-through
  • Ability to manage fast-moving hiring pipelines
  • Comfortable coordinating across U.S. time zones
  • Able to work independently in a remote environment

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Stay organized across multiple simultaneous searches

jobs.description:
Introduction

WaterConnect LLC (“WaterConnect”) is a project development company dedicated to creating opportunities for construction-stage investment in water supply and sanitation (WSS) infrastructure in low- and middle-income countries. We bring early-stage financing and technical expertise to complement local partners, develop new infrastructure, and deploy technology that will impact water access, quality, and scarcity, and in turn build resilience for households and watersheds.

WaterConnect partners with infrastructure developers, utilities, engineering firms, technology providers and equipment suppliers to co-develop infrastructure projects, bringing them from concept to financial close and construction. With the goal of accelerating the flow of projects, WaterConnect offers project development funding and expertise, particularly in legal and financial structuring, capital raising, and social and environmental impact, to supplement the pre-existing resources of project co-developers. WaterConnect seeks to develop a range of water projects, including both public private partnership projects for municipal infrastructure, as well as private industrial projects that mitigate water scarcity and reduce wastewater discharges. WaterConnect coordinates closely with sister organizations, Water.org and WaterEquity, which offer complementary products, including private equity and construction-stage infrastructure project financing.

WaterConnect is in its third year of operations after spinning off from Water.org in 2024. It represents the latest in a series of innovations by Water.org to catalyze investment into water supply and sanitation in pursuit of achieving access for all, as highlighted by UN Sustainable Development Goal 6.

Summary

WaterConnect is seeking a meticulous, self-motivated Finance and Accounting Manager to safeguard and strengthen the financial foundation of a high-impact, fast-growing infrastructure investment platform. This is an opportunity to join a startup company backed by a larger global group, working at the intersection of treasury, accounting, and reporting for a mission-driven organization.

The Finance and Accounting Manager oversees WaterConnect's internal financial operations, ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant management of the organization's finances. This role is responsible for treasury and liquidity management, vendor and banking relationships, and financial reporting. It also oversees sound accounting procedures and controls, manages the day-to-day and period-end close process, and ensures compliance with applicable accounting and tax regulations.

Working closely with Water.org's finance team, the Finance and Accounting Manager will play a key role in financial statement consolidation and in maintaining the financial integrity that supports WaterConnect's mission. The role offers significant visibility, a direct line to management, and the chance to grow with the company.

Job Responsibilities

Internal Financial Services

  • Oversee bank accounts and payments to vendors, projects, intercompanies, payroll, and reimbursements
  • Oversee liquidity management and reserve balances, including cash flow monitoring and forecasting
  • Manage relationships with banking partners, auditors, and tax advisors
  • Prepare and deliver financial reports and forecasts for management, the parent company, and governing bodies

Accounting and Controls

  • Oversee accounting, including day-to-day and period-end closing processes, in partnership with a third-party accounting provider
  • Establish and enforce proper finance and accounting procedures and controls, including capitalization of project expenses
  • Lead aspects of finance department collaboration with the parent company, including consolidation
  • Prepare annual tax filings and ensure compliance with applicable accounting and tax regulations
  • Support the annual external audit process and respond to auditor requests
  • Monitor and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances to support accurate consolidation

How to Apply

Submit a cover letter with salary requirements and a resume. Both documents must be in English.

WaterConnect is an equal-opportunity employer. WaterConnect recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

Don't meet every single requirement? If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience does not perfectly match every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Your unique skills and perspective could make you the ideal candidate for this position.

Requirements

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 5 or more years of progressive experience in accounting and finance roles, including treasury, financial reporting, and the accounting close process
  • Professional accounting qualification (e.g., CPA, CMA, CA, ACCA) or equivalent demonstrated expertise
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS, with experience supporting multi-entity or parent-subsidiary consolidation
  • Experience managing banking relationships, treasury operations, and liquidity or cash management
  • Experience working with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory bodies; familiarity with international tax compliance considerations
  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and enforce sound accounting procedures and internal controls
  • Proficiency with accounting software or ERP systems and advanced Excel skills
  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a small, virtual team in a hands-on role
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, multicultural teams
  • Demonstrated commitment to social and environmental impact
  • Proficient (written and verbal) in English

Preferred:

  • Experience in infrastructure finance
  • Experience with international transactions, multi-currency accounting, and reporting across international entities

Physical Requirements:

Role includes regular online collaboration across time zones. Colleagues, partners, and service providers are based in the Americas, Africa, India, and East Asia. While the role is fully remote, to ensure real-time overlap with the President and Water.org’s finance team during core business hours, we require candidates to be based in the Eastern or Central time zone. This role involves extended periods of sitting and reaching. This role requires the ability to see, talk, and hear. Travel may be required up to 10% of the time.

Benefits

This position offers full-time benefits, including medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible spending plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) plan, and periodic review for merit and incentive pay based on organizational and personal achievement. Overall compensation will be commensurate with education and experience and structured to reflect a competitive package for a full-time team member.

Expected pay range is $80,000 to 110,000 per year.

No relocation benefits, work permit reimbursement, or visa sponsorship will be offered.

  • Purpose-driven: The how behind all your projects is driven by a clear definition of why we're solving the problem.

  • Agent-first: You’re obsessive about pushing agents to their limits and often eschew UIs in favor of agent-first interactions.

  • Product sense: You love great software and can't stand bad software. You have a strong focus on craft, quality, and the ability to deeply empathize with the end user to deliver delightful experiences.

  • Systems thinker: You see how the pieces connect. You're as comfortable reasoning about an ingestion pipeline's throughput as you are about the dashboard a customer sees, and you understand how decisions at one layer ripple through the others.

  • High agency: You are motivated to achieve success and have a strong sense of ownership to deliver great outcomes across a broad range of responsibilities. Even if it's not your responsibility, if you see something that needs to be done, you make sure it happens.

  • Business acumen: You understand how technical solutions tie to business objectives and can align projects to meet customer and company goals.

  • 8+ years of product experience, especially with data platforms, data infrastructure, analytics, or developer tools.

  • Proven track record of successfully bringing data products to market and driving strategy across multiple teams or a platform-scale product area.

  • Strong understanding of modern data architectures: event/streaming pipelines, data warehousing and lakehouse patterns, data modeling, and the trade-offs of processing data at scale.

  • Experience with both platform products (where the customer is internal teams or developers) and end-user-facing data products (analytics, observability, insights, experimentation), and an understanding of how the two must work together.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. jobs.description:
We're looking for an ERP Implementation and Support Specialist to become the go-to internal expert for a custom ERP system currently in its final stages of development. You will own end-to-end ERP knowledge, train team members across departments, provide ongoing support, and ensure the system is adopted and used correctly across the organization.

This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role. You will not be implementing a third-party ERP from scratch — you will be deeply learning a proprietary system and becoming the person the entire company relies on when they have questions, encounter issues, or need training. If you have strong experience with recognized ERP platforms, learn new systems quickly, and take genuine ownership of making sure people actually use the tools they are given, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Become the central ERP knowledge owner for a growing company building its operational infrastructure
  • High-ownership role with direct impact on how the entire organization runs day to day

What You'll Work On

ERP Onboarding and Training

  • Learn the company's proprietary ERP system thoroughly and become the internal subject matter expert
  • Develop and deliver training materials, guides, and walkthroughs for team members across departments
  • Onboard new users and ensure they are comfortable and confident operating in the system
  • Identify knowledge gaps and proactively address them before they become workflow problems

Ongoing Support and Troubleshooting

  • Serve as the first point of contact for ERP-related questions, issues, and troubleshooting requests
  • Diagnose and resolve user issues quickly and accurately
  • Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate internal or external team with full context
  • Maintain a support log and track recurring issues to identify patterns and systemic gaps

System Documentation and Process Management

  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including SOPs, user guides, and process maps for all ERP workflows
  • Keep documentation current as the system evolves and new features are added
  • Ensure team members always have access to accurate, up-to-date reference materials

System Adoption and Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor system usage and adoption across the organization and flag areas of underutilization or confusion
  • Gather feedback from users and surface improvement opportunities to leadership and the development team
  • Support testing and rollout of system updates, new modules, and workflow changes

What You Bring

  • Proven experience working with at least one recognized ERP platform such as NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Acumatica, Epicor Prophet 21, Sage, Odoo, Infor, or SAP
  • Strong ability to learn new systems quickly and become a deep subject matter expert without formal hand-holding
  • Experience training or supporting non-technical end users in ERP or similar enterprise software environments
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to explain complex system workflows in plain language
  • Highly organized with strong documentation habits and attention to detail
  • Patient, clear communicator who can support users of varying technical ability without frustration
  • Self-directed and reliable with the ability to own a support function independently

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting ERP implementations or system rollouts in a distribution, wholesale, or product-based business
  • Background in US accounting workflows including inventory management, order management, or financial reporting within an ERP
  • Experience creating training programs or user documentation for enterprise software
  • Familiarity with ERP customization, configuration, or module setup
  • Prior experience as an ERP administrator, power user, or internal systems trainer

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your ERP experience including which platforms you have worked with and at what depth, and explaining how you would approach becoming the go-to expert for a system you have never used before

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a fast learner who can go deep on a new system, train others with patience and clarity, and take full ownership of making sure ERP adoption actually happens across an organization, this role gives you the scope and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.description:
Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

Location: This position is remote within the United States or Canada.

Role Summary

Censys is seeking a Staff Backend Engineer to join our Exposure Management teamand provide the technical leadership foundation as we evolve our legacy Attack Surface Management (ASM) product into the next-generation Exposure Management offering on our platform. We’re currently building our Supply Chain Intelligence module and will expand to first-party Exposure Management. This work requires deep technical ownership, the ability to bridge legacy and new systems, and the judgment to balance ongoing customer commitments with long-term migration. We’re looking for an engineer who can act as the technical lead for the area, build and extend large-scale, real-time streaming services that leverage our massive datasets, drive cross-team alignment, and mentor the existing team.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the Tech Lead for the Exposure Management team, driving technical direction across services and strengthening architecture and system design practices, with the ultimate goal of helping our customer reduce their attack surface exposures.
  • Own the migration plan and execution to bring legacy ASM functionality onto the new Exposure Management platform, balancing customer commitments on the legacy product with the long-term migration roadmap.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of backend services, resolving complex legacy behavior and ensuring seamless interoperability with the new platform.
  • Drive technical alignment across shared systems, improving coordination, scalability, and engineering effectiveness.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence through mentorship, architectural leadership, and high engineering standards.
  • Leverage AI and LLM technologies to improve engineering efficiency, streamline development workflows, and enhance intelligent capabilities within the Exposure Management platform.

What You’ll Bring

  • A positive attitude biased towards action and iterative problem solving, even in legacy code where the answer isn’t obvious
  • A deep understanding of how the Internet works. For example, WHOIS, Certificate Subject Alternative Names (SANs), and DNS record types should not be foreign to you
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering
  • 5+ years of experience with Go
  • Strong distributed systems background, including the ability to build horizontally scalable systems with high availability and fault-tolerance
  • Experience with service-oriented architectures and the operational stack to support them (gRPC/REST, microservices, GCP, Kubernetes)
  • Ability to quickly navigate unfamiliar legacy systems, reverse-engineer existing behavior, and resolve complex issues with minimal disruption to execution.
  • Strong communication and technical design skills, including the ability to clearly document architectures, identify systemic gaps, and drive solutions from concept through implementation.
  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What Sets You Apart

  • Go as your primary backend language
  • Passion for integrating AI and LLM technologies into engineering workflows to improve velocity, automation, and product experience.
  • Experience leading product migrations or platform consolidations, balancing legacy customer commitments with new development on a parallel platform
  • Familiarity with microservice-based designs using GCP PubSub or similar event-driven architectures
  • You understand the value of building maintainable software. Some of your first tasks when building a new service are ensuring test coverage enforced by CI, adding linters, and adding code complexity checks. You enjoy a good abstraction, and promote established design patterns, but also know when to think outside the box

For high cost of living areas (San Francisco Bay, New York City, and Seattle), the expected salary range for this position is $198,000 USD – $233,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

For all other US locations, the expected salary range for this position is $172,000 USD – $216,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified. For roles that are available to be filled remotely, the pay range is localized according to employee work location by a factor of between 83% and 100% of range. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information.

Censys offers a competitive benefits package to employees, including equity, health, dental & vision coverage, retirement with company contribution, parental leave, mental health & wellness benefits, flexible PTO, and a professional development stipend. Censys also offers sales incentive pay for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates to keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired, we would love to bring you to our HQ in Ann Arbor for in-person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with our Censys Privacy Policy.

The principal travels constantly across multiple continents and expects an EA who responds quickly, anticipates needs, and handles logistics with zero margin for error. Being exceptionally responsive is not a nice-to-have here — it is the baseline. A strong plus is the ability to support content creation alongside the operational work. Travel Booking and Coordination

  • Coordinate logistics across venues, tour staff, managers, and agents across multiple time zones

Calendar and Schedule Management

  • Own a constantly moving, high-complexity calendar with complete accuracy across show dates, travel windows, meetings, press, and personal commitments
  • Communicate schedule updates clearly and ahead of time to all relevant parties
  • Ensure no conflicts, overlaps, or timing risks at any point in the schedule
  • Keep the principal and their team informed and prepared for every commitment

Day-to-Day Executive Support

  • Manage logistics, reminders, checklists, and time-sensitive updates proactively
  • Communicate with managers, agents, tour staff, venues, and assistants on behalf of the principal
  • Maintain organized documentation for travel history, receipts, preferences, and key contacts

What You Bring

  • High level of discretion and professionalism when working with a high-profile individual and their family
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Unmatched attention to detail — accuracy is non-negotiable in this role
  • Comfortable handling confidential information and working in a high-trust environment
  • Strong overlap with US Pacific Time hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting entertainers, talent, public figures, or high-profile families
  • Content creation or social media experience alongside an operational support role
  • Background coordinating travel across multiple continents simultaneously
  • Familiarity with tour logistics, venue coordination, or entertainment industry workflows
  • Experience managing logistics for a family, not just an individual principal

How to Apply

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience booking complex international travel and managing high-stakes calendars, and explaining how you stay on top of a fast-moving schedule when multiple things change at once

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are detail-obsessed, exceptionally responsive, and can keep a global touring schedule running without missing a beat, this role gives you the trust, the access, and the direct impact to do your best work.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a strong Senior Product Manager to lead Kyivstar Identity Provider (KIP) – the unified identity layer that powers the entire Kyivstar Group consumer ecosystem. In this role, you will own the product end-to-end: strategy, P&L as the ecosystem develops, KPIs and OKRs, roadmap prioritization, partner integrations, stakeholder management at C-level, customer development, and the user-facing surfaces of KIP. Your goal is to make KIP the operational instrument that turns the Kyivstar Group portfolio into a real ecosystem.

KIP is both a platform and a consumer product. The platform side serves partner products – that depend on KIP for authentication, consent, and cross-product capabilities. The consumer side serves the millions of users who sign in, manage their profiles, control their consents, see their subscriptions, and recover their accounts through Kyivstar ID. You will own both sides.

You will join an experienced team – engineers, designers, business analysts, QA specialists, product analysts, security, and reliability – that is already building KIP and has integrated the first wave of products. We are looking for someone who is genuinely comfortable with ambiguity, who drives ideas through to outcomes rather than waiting for direction, who can hold their position in architectural and commercial debates, and who treats active partner relationships as an organizational challenge rather than an excuse.

About the product

KIP is the identity and consent layer for the Kyivstar Group consumer ecosystem. It is built on OAuth 2.0 and is the platform every consumer product in the portfolio authenticates against. It enables cross-product use cases – frictionless onboarding across products, contextual personalization, unified subscriptions, portfolio-wide CVM – that are structurally impossible without a unified identity layer.

What you will do

  • Owning KIP end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, partner integrations, the user-facing cabinet, and the cross-product capabilities that turn the portfolio into an ecosystem
  • Setting team goals, KPIs, and OKRs aligned with Kyivstar Group's ecosystem strategy and driving maximum business impact across the portfolio
  • Owning P&L as the ecosystem develops – managing the commercial design of cross-product use cases, attribution between partners, and revenue model evolution
  • Managing active partner relationships – coordinating their integration timelines, resolving roadmap conflicts, and protecting partner P&L during migration to KIP
  • Driving the architectural conversation with partners and internal stakeholders, including holding the line on the chosen integration model when it is challenged, and adjusting it deliberately when the evidence warrants
  • Developing and creating buy-in of product strategy at C-1 and C-level (CTO, CISO, CEO of Kyivstar Group, and JSC Kyivstar) and for partner product leadership
  • Identifying new product opportunities, revenue drivers, and synergic use cases that compound value across the ecosystem
  • Working closely with discovery, engineering, security, and design teams to deliver and measure features, and going deep into business and system analysis to ensure decisions are sound
  • Collaborating with FP&A, Legal, Tech, Marketing, Customer Support, Risk, and Compliance – KIP touches all of them because it serves the whole portfolio
  • Prioritizing the KIP roadmap and aligning it with the IT roadmap of the company, while managing risks, setting expectations, identifying dependencies, and forecasting future development

Qualifications and experience needed

  • 5+ years of experience in product management with proven success defined by metrics. Experience managing products through the complete lifecycle, from ideation to scaled operation
  • Experience with platform, identity, payments, or other infrastructure-class products is a strong plus. Direct experience with identity products (SSO, IdP, account management) is the strongest plus
  • Understanding of OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect at the conceptual level, and the ability to engage substantively with technical architecture debates. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to know why an architectural choice matters and be able to defend or revise it on evidence
  • Strong technical proficiency to engage effectively with engineering teams: API design principles, system integration patterns, ability to evaluate technological architecture trade-offs, and explain them to non-technical stakeholders
  • Result-oriented mindset. We measure outcomes, not activity. If you need a perfect spec before you start, this is not the role for you
  • Proactive by default. You drive ideas through to outcomes: chasing partner alignment, unblocking decisions, and writing the document yourself when it needs to be written. You do not wait for direction on what to do next
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. KIP operates in a space where the right answer is often genuinely unclear and where partner positions, regulatory frameworks, and ecosystem strategy all evolve. You need to be able to make defensible decisions with incomplete information and revise them when better information arrives
  • Strong organization and project management skills. Partner integrations, multiple internal stakeholders, and tier-0 operational obligations create real complexity. The role rewards people who structure work clearly and keep many moving parts on track
  • Strong leadership skills, ability to create and translate product vision, and drive the team to ensure progress
  • Strong stakeholder management at the C-1 level. You need to be able to hold a peer-to-peer conversation, push back constructively, and communicate restraint and analytical judgment rather than enthusiasm
  • Understanding the specifics of the telco business is a must. Understanding adjacent verticals (ride-hailing, health, content, retail) is a plus
  • 1+ years of people management experience will be a plus
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in Ukrainian and English. You will write strategy documents, partner-facing materials, and executive presentations regularly
  • Willingness to tackle any challenges on the path to building Ukraine's digital identity layer

What we offer

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Zimperium® is the world leader in mobile security, purpose-built to protect the modern mobile enterprise. Trusted by leading organizations and governments, our AI-driven platform delivers real-time, on-device protection for mobile applications and devices. We help organizations stay ahead with proactive defense against evolving threats—including mobile-targeted phishing (mishing), malware, app vulnerabilities, and zero-day exploits. Our mission is to empower organizations to operate securely and confidently in today’s dynamic digital environment.

We are seeking a highly skilled and inquisitive security engineer with deep technical expertise in mobile threat detection and operating system internals. This role focuses on conducting forensics analysis of potentially compromised devices to research, develop, and improve our detection capabilities against advanced mobile threats. Experience in analyzing data from iOS backups and diagnose is at the core of the role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with an open and adaptive research mindset, maintaining versatility across diverse security challenges. A strong ability to code for the iOS environment, alongside conducting and reviewing high-quality technical work, is essential for success in this position.

Location: Europe

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, and implement new detection techniques and algorithms for the iOS platform based on forensics data coming both from the runtime environment and the offline iOS sysdiagnose and backup files.
  • Lead and participate in structured brainstorming sessions to generate novel detection ideas against advanced mobile threats.
  • Analyze, document and make use of iOS internals features in an attempt to improve the runtime and offline detection capabilities.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve internal tooling and automation to accelerate analysis, triage, and detection development.
  • Review and interpret forensic data provided by customers, produce clear technical reports, and provide actionable guidance and remediation support.
  • Write and publish technical blog posts to raise awareness of emerging security risks and share insights with customers and the wider security community.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment, including forming and leading focused sub-groups to deliver specific project features or research objectives.
  • Strong knowledge of iOS operating system internals (e.g., diagnose, encrypted backup, daemons/services, sandboxing, code-signing), with a particular focus on the capability to use the data provided by the operating system to detect a compromised device.
  • Good previous experience in data analysis methods applied to forensics investigations.
  • Proficiency in reverse engineering using tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Hopper, or equivalent, including experience writing scripts, leveraging their SDKs, and isolating and reporting technical issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to think both offensively and defensively, approaching analysis tasks with the mindset of both an attacker and a defender.
  • Solid programming experience in C, Python, Objective-C and Swift, with the ability to produce efficient, maintainable, and secure code.
  • Capability to reverse engineer proprietary protocols and interprocess communication mechanisms (e.g., XPC, mach messages, IOKit) is considered a plus.

Why Mozilla

Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of Firefox, the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit.

Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the 501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation, meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms.

Firefox Enterprise is a new team within Mozilla that is addressing the needs of business and government customers for a secure enterprise browser that gives organizations greater control over their data, policies, and digital infrastructure. We’re now seeking a Senior Strategic Account Executive, Firefox Enterprise (DACH) to help grow Firefox Enterprise across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. jobs.excerpt: For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations.
jobs.description:
For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations. We embed directly in government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

Your Impact

Someone on Medicaid hands a prescription to a pharmacist and finds out, right there at the counter, whether it is covered and what it will cost. That answer was settled long before they walked in, through rebate agreements and pricing data that determine what states pay for medication, and through safety checks that flag when two prescriptions should not be taken together.

For People and its partners build the system at the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services behind those answers. It is how the federal government tracks drug pricing across every state Medicaid program, holds drug manufacturers to the agreements they signed, and returns billions of dollars in rebates to state and federal budgets each year. Much of it runs on software that has been added to for years without ever being fully rethought.

You will be one of the engineers rethinking it. You will work on the back-end of the platform, including the services, the data, and the interfaces everything else depends on as part of a small scrum team inside a larger program. That means shipping new features and steadily modernizing what is already there, including the next version of the program's drug utilization review tools and the checks that help catch dangerous prescription combinations before they reach a patient.

Our Culture

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first.

This position is 100% remote. Our entire team is remote across the United States, from the West Coast to the East Coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none!

This position's published base salary range is between $100,000 and $120,000 annually. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

Occasional travel (1 or 2 times per year) is required for in-person program planning. These trips are infrequent and scheduled well in advance.

Your Opportunities

On the Medicaid Drug Program project, you will work primarily on the back-end of the platform to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain the services and interfaces behind the platform using Java and the Spring Boot framework
  • Work with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, for efficient data storage, retrieval, and management
  • Contribute to the next version of the program's drug utilization review tools
  • Help lead the team's automated testing practice, including unit, integration, and performance tests
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues in the production system
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code aligning with the team's coding standards, and offer constructive feedback through code review
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and quarterly planning across teams

You Bring

  • A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People's values— how we work with passion, fun, curiosity and sustainability, humility and respect
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong Java programming ability, including working proficiency with the Spring Boot framework
  • Solid database design and data modeling skills, with experience creating and maintaining data models
  • Proven ability to read, understand, and safely change a large codebase you did not write
  • Experience with version control systems, such as Git, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Experience writing automated tests and working in Agile development environments

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Familiarity with front-end frameworks such as Angular. This won't be a core responsibility area, but the application is Angular-based, and occasionally flexing into the front-end is needed.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure
  • Prior work on healthcare, Medicaid, or other public benefits systems

Some fine print. You will be working on a United States government platform, and they have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. You must perform all work physically within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a government-performed public trust background check.

For People is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, and/or veteran status.
